## Source: amazon-inspector (6be2f131c6ccc3795c4cee48c62afe35c2b1290d788d2f59a83abc887ebde897)
Analysis of speakbench 0.1.0 across 10 files produced no indicators of installer-side harm. No install-time or import-time network activity, no credential or filesystem secret reads, no fetch-and-execute of remote content, no lifecycle-script shell execution, and no obfuscated or hardcoded exfiltration destinations were observed.

## Source: kam193 (5261cd9950cdef43aa82af72e1a479d8668a37b06d1fce0a6b8ff869e0620ed2)
This campaign consists of similar loader packages, which provide executing code from a given URL. While they do not contain the malicious payload and the usage remains unknown, they are clearly a coordinated campaign to place multiple deceptive ways to load malicious code.
